# actions

```go
import "github.com/colonel-byte/cargoship/pkg/packager/actions"
```

Package actions runs the onCreate actions in a distro package.

Derived from zarf's src/pkg/packager/actions and the network half of src/pkg/wait. zarf's wait package serves both cluster and network waits from one file, so importing it for a network probe linked k8s.io/kubectl, k8s.io/cli\-runtime and sigs.k8s.io/kustomize \- about 5.9MB of a binary that never has a cluster to wait on, because cargoship runs actions only at package create time. See docs/agent/choice\-actions\-fork.md.
